featured_reviews.name: Devangi Dave
featured_reviews.review_text:
Whether you’re a local resident or just passing through Vikhroli East, K Salon & Spa has carved out a reputation as a reliable sanctuary for grooming and relaxation. In a bustling neighborhood where high-end service often comes with a steep price tag, this establishment strikes a commendable balance between professional expertise and approachable pricing, pocket-friendly yet premium grooming session in Vikhroli, K Salon & Spa at Tagore Nagar is a standout choice. My recent visit for a combined Facial and Hair Spa session proved that you don't need to travel to a high-end mall to get "Red Carpet" ready.

Here is a breakdown of the experience.
Upon entering K Salon & Spa, the first thing you notice is the meticulous attention to hygiene—a factor that has become a non-negotiable for modern clients. The interiors are clean, well-lit, and designed with a contemporary aesthetic that instantly lowers your heart rate. It doesn't feel like a cramped local parlour; instead, it leans into a "boutique" vibe that makes you feel like a valued guest rather than just another appointment on a ledger.

1. The Hair Spa:
The session began with a detailed hair analysis. Unlike many salons that jump straight to the washbasin, the stylists here take a moment to check your scalp health and hair porosity. After a deep cleansing wash, they applied a nourishing cream mask tailored to my dry ends. The highlight was the 15-minute head and shoulder massage. The pressure was firm but relaxing, effectively melting away a week’s worth of desk-job tension. The steam treatment was timed perfectly—not too hot, but enough to let the product penetrate. After the final rinse and a professional blow-dry, my hair felt significantly softer and had a visible, healthy sheen without feeling weighed down by silicone.

2. The Facial:
The facial isn't just a regular cream-and-steam session; it’s a high-potency professional treatment. At K Salon, they follow the authentic multi-step protocol. Unlike soapy cleansers, this feels more like a treatment that starts breaking down surface pigmentation immediately. The exfoliation is thorough. The staff is well-trained to be gentle around the nose and chin while ensuring all dead skin cells are removed. This is where the magic happens. The massage with the cream helps boost blood circulation, making your skin feel "awake" and plump. They apply a thick, cooling mask that seals in the nutrients. You will walk out looking significantly fairer and "cleaner." My skin felt incredibly smooth—almost like a primed canvas. The use of high-quality, branded products ensures that results—whether it's a glowing complexion after a clean-up or the perfect drape of a bridal makeover—are long-lasting and satisfying.

The staff at K Salon & Spa are consistently noted for their polite and professional demeanor. There is a distinct lack of the "hard-sell" culture found in many chain salons; you won’t be pressured into buying expensive aftercare products unless you ask. I appreciated that the staff didn't spend the entire hour trying to sell me expensive shampoos or follow-up packages.  Overall, a very great experience at an affordable rate yet feels premium like a SOBO Salon / Boutique.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi, I visited Champ Spot Salon today. I have been a regular customer there for many years, and I genuinely appreciate their services and the quality of their work.
Today, being a Sunday, I visited around 8 PM. I had something urgent to attend to, and as Sundays are usually busy for everyone, I asked the staff how long it would take. They told me it would take about 30 minutes, so I decided to wait.
There was one customer before me who was getting her eyebrows done. Once she finished, it was my turn. At that point, one of the staff members called me over in a visibly irritated tone. While doing my eyebrows, she started complaining to her colleague, saying, "Why didn't you tell her it would take an hour?" She then went on to say, "She comes here just to pass time. I have to spend 15 minutes on her eyebrows."
What upset me even more was when she said, "People come for a ₹50 service and waste 15 minutes of our time."
I found this comment extremely unprofessional and disrespectful. Whether a customer comes for a ₹50 service or a ₹1,000 service, every customer deserves the same level of respect. It is the salon's responsibility to either accept the service request or politely decline if they are unable to accommodate the customer due to closing hours or workload.
I completely understand and accept that I arrived late in the evening. However, if it was inconvenient, the staff could have simply informed me that they were about to close and could not take any more customers. I would have understood and left without any issue.
What I cannot accept is being spoken about negatively while sitting there as a customer, especially being made to feel as though my service was not worth their time because it was only a ₹50 job. I have always appreciated Champ Spot Salon's service, which is why I have continued visiting for years, but I believe such remarks and behaviour towards customers are unacceptable and do not reflect the professionalism that customers expect.
Please brief Your Staff.
